title: navarretia leptalea subsp. bicolor
intro: Navarretia leptalea subsp. bicolor, commonly known as the Yellow to Purple Gilia, is a plant species in the phlox family, characterized by its unique yellow and purple flowers. The health benefits of Navarretia leptalea subsp. bicolor include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant may include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Navarretia leptalea subsp. bicolor include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
